line: Then real school began. Greek thinker Aristotle wrote that in education PRACTICE must come before theory, and the body before the mind. Your school had other plans.
credit: ARISTOTLE · POLITICS VIII · TR. JOWETT, REV. ROSS 1921 (retold)
